messages:
Maria G (Finance): Heads up — got a chargeback today for acct cust_8923. EUR 4,200 on 2026-03-20. Bank reason: ‘Not authorized’ and MCC shows 4829 (money transfer). That MCC doesn't match the customer's normal activity. Filing here to gather evidence.
Ajay K (Payments): tx id and gateway?
Maria G (Finance): tx_3a7f9c — gateway: stripe. last4: 4242, BIN: 453987, settled 2026-03-20 14:12 UTC. dispute case id posted by bank: BK-77821. Screenshot attached in ticket (link: https://redwood.internal/s/attach/tx_3a7f9c). 
Frank L (Risk): suspicious. BIN 453987 maps to UK issuing bank (checking). Do we have IP/device info? Any recent velocity spikes on this acct?
Sana (Ops): Pulling logs now. Quick query I ran:
```
select ts, ip, country, user_agent from payments.events where tx_id='tx_3a7f9c';
```
Result: 2026-03-20T14:11:50Z ip=51.140.31.7 country=NL ua="Stripe-Checkout (iOS)". No prior NL logins on record.
Ajay K (Payments): Also note stripe dispute reason code CHARGEBACK_FRAUD. Bank says cardholder reports unauthorized. We should prepare evidence packet: receipt, customer email confirmation, IP, webhook, signed TOS acceptance.
Maria G (Finance): Customer support ticket (SUP-2209) shows user claims they didn't authorize the charge. They asked for refund on 2026-03-21. CS says they were asked to reverify but no successful auth flow recorded.
Emily (CS): I chatted with the user — they said they saw a third-party payment app charge them and don't recognize it. They provided a screenshot of the merchant name which maps to our partner integrator, not Redwood. Sending the screenshot to #partners.
Frank L (Risk): Pattern check: search for transactions using BIN 453987 in last 30 days — I see 14 transactions flagged, 9 from NL, 5 from DE, two chargebacks already. Could be a BIN cluster exploited by a bot.
Ajay K (Payments): Can ops dump webhook payload and receipt HTML. Bank needs proof of customer interaction (email, IP, billing zip if any). Also: any 3DS status? 
Sana (Ops): 3DS status = not_authenticated. No AVS match (billing postal blank). We have webhook event payload: session_metadata and email. Pasting redacted snippet:
```
{"id":"evt_1Kx","type":"checkout.session.completed","data":{"customer_email":"joe@example.com","client_ip":"51.140.31.7","payment_status":"paid"}}
```
Ajay K (Payments): Ok. That's weak for defending a fraud dispute. We should escalate to Chargebacks Ops and Risk for manual review. I'll start the dispute response to Stripe (60 days window) and add evidence but flag likely lost.
Maria G (Finance): Do we pause the customer's account or freeze payouts to partner integrator? Partner payouts scheduled tomorrow.
Frank L (Risk): Freeze payouts to the integrator until we triage. Create a short investigation: classify as high-risk if more than 3 chargebacks in 7 days for same BIN/merchant.
dispute-bot: Automated update — dispute BK-77821 created at 2026-03-22T09:04:12Z. Status: awaiting_response.
Emily (CS): I'll message the customer asking for any receipts, device used, and whether they used any third-party apps that might have 'hidden' merchant name. Keep it short.
Sana (Ops): Ops checklist posted in thread: 1) Export full webhook and refund logs, 2) Screenshot of checkout page + hosted invoice, 3) IP + geo copy, 4) 3DS/AVS/charge descriptor. Done for tx_3a7f9c — uploading to shared folder.
Ajay K (Payments): I'll assemble evidence. Plan: submit email receipt, checkout HTML, IP + geo, webhook payload, support transcript. Add note about 3DS failure and AVS missing. Bank likely to rule for cardholder but we will try.
Maria G (Finance): Noted. Also looping in Partnerships to confirm merchant mapping (this may be partner integrator mislabel). @Emily (CS) please flag any contract terms that show partner liability.
Emily (CS): Will do. I already pinged Partnerships.
Frank L (Risk): Quick mitigation: add BIN 453987 to monitoring rule to route transactions through stricter checks (force 3DS or block). Can infra add a temporary rule?
Sana (Ops): Adding rule to staging now. Will push to prod after 1h smoke test. 
Maria G (Finance): Thanks everyone. If the bank accepts chargeback we should reserve funds for EUR 4,200 and notify accounting for reconciliation. I'll open a journal entry for reserve.
Ajay K (Payments): Putting a hold on partner payout and marking transaction as disputed in ledger.
Maria G (Finance): Follow-ups: Frank, if you confirm cluster, we'll open fraud ticket with card network. Emily, confirm partner contract. Ops, deliver evidence packet to Stripe and to bank (BK-77821). Meeting in 30 if we need to escalate.
Frank L (Risk): On it. I'll share the cluster analysis in the incident channel if pattern holds. :eyes:
Emily (CS): sending partner contract note shortly.
dispute-bot: Reminder — dispute BK-77821 requires response by 2026-05-21.
